svg.text: FOILS & FOUNDERS: THE AOTEAROA DECK — MACRO HYDROFOIL & TE WAKA HOURUA MAT
Rule Zero (B:00 — The Rawlsian D20 Test): "Not all lives are easy, but none should be impossible."
ZONE 1: THE RAWLSIAN D20 BIRTH & ENDOGENOUS HAZARD COMPASS (20 WEALTH VIGINTILES)
Cover Red/Amber Reefs by Locking Subsystems 1, 2, & 3 Below ("Make Your Own Luck")
BOTTOM REEF (1-6): T:00/T:01/T:05 | Closed by BAY 1 (B:01+B:02)
3-YR TERM AUDIT (1-8): Triggers H:01/H:02 on Unshielded Stakes | Closed by BAY 3 (B:07)
TOP REEF (19-20): T:02/T:04 | Closed by BAY 2 (B:05)

Regime Multipliers: [Any 2 Bays = SS1 (2x Mana!)] • [All 3 Bays + Cap = SS2 (3x Mana!)]
